scope: Current HP1 weight statistics; historical CPU Q4_0-body head captures and controls; current HP1 weight-only FP64 replay on those fixed inputs. Not current PoTal PPL or backend arithmetic.
sampling: 4 scored head rows per chunk: offsets 0,64,128,192; all 32 historical chunks. Full vocabulary. Fixed deterministic sample; different tokenizers cover different text extents.
reference: Llama FP16 head reused from an archived original-F16 control model. All head statistics and fine histograms, including HP1 errors against it, rechecked against the whole-source-SHA-verified analysis. Archived model and head SHA are recorded separately.
metrics: Logit errors are centered per row across vocabulary; this removes softmax-invariant constant offsets. Top1 is agreement with the FP16-head replay, not ground-truth accuracy. KL uses that replay's full-vocabulary probability distribution. Top3-only error is a separate projection; its energy is not additive with remaining channels.
